description: This file defines the Coocook::Controller::Settings class, a controller component for handling user settings in a web application. It includes methods for managing account details, password changes, organization memberships, and project listings, with routing and access control logic.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Settings
classes.description: Controller class managing user settings, including account info, password, organizations, and projects.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Sets up the base chain for settings routes, defining submenu items.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Redirects to the account settings page.

methods.name: account
methods.description: Displays account settings, including email change options.

methods.name: change_display_name
methods.description: Handles updating the user's display name.

methods.name: change_password
methods.description: Handles password change requests, including validation and session management.

methods.name: organizations
methods.description: Displays organizations the user belongs to, with options to leave or create.

methods.name: projects
methods.description: Lists projects associated with the user.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to add a message and redirect to the index.
